retainedFailures.reason: Only existing reachable+abandoned diagnostic expected ARTIFACT_NOT_COMMITTED/protected outcome; new terminal witness correctly refuses contradictory terminal+reachable authority. Strengthened original child assertions to require AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE for abandon/outcome/collect/inspect and exact surviving ciphertext; all new witness children passed.
New generic SqlTransaction test decorator initially returned unspecialized QueryResult<Record>; repaired explicit generic forwarding. Full failed strict build retained.

limitations: Local anti-rollback qualifies only exact staging terminal PG snapshot rollback or microsecond timestamp alteration while independent installed witness/current identity/control/material authority survive; snapshot test restores an owned reproducible terminal table, not a content backup/restore product journey
Witness is never caller input, in content/backup roots, automatically initialized from a PG snapshot, or archived; control records contain opaque IDs/binding/times only and no descriptive data/keys

Enrollment surviving reservation rollback rejects restaging; absent/pending/UNKNOWN_COMMIT never authorize replay. Intent surviving abandonment rollback/ACK gap blocks confirmation/publication and protects physical GC until explicit current-authenticated reconciliation

Current authenticated maintenance authority, original actor/exact installed material/root/generation/native historical maintenance lineage/full Task audience and Space-first original locks remain required. Terminal+reachable contradiction refuses all operations including administrative inspect

Witness bounded to 1024 original directories/4KiB reads; no compaction or authority-root rollback/loss recovery. Whole-service/PG-host death or witness append process death/hard-link interruption recovery is unqualified and may fail closed on temporary links; no automatic authority repair
Existing filesystem-worker SIGKILL schedules retain surviving PG parent/witness and ephemeral keys; no whole-host/hardware power-loss/multi-host/host administrator qualification

Authenticated canonical publication/settled original content-command integration remains active f05-03; canonical encrypted save/event/outbox remains f05-04.
